wiki.summary: The track is part of a broader project heavily focused on the themes of betrayal, loyalty, and the aftermath of his 2024 feud with Kendrick Lamar, exploring the isolation and paranoia that followed. ‘A little birdie said’ is an idiom used to reveal that you know something secret or private, while intentionally hiding the source of that information Read more on Last.fm.
